items.text: An offline Yosemite Valley map drawn from NPS geometry: roads with one-way arrows, trails and bike paths, buildings with name modes, parking, waterways, shuttle routes and your saved pins.
A directory of 253 places with hours, access, contacts, menus, nearby stops and sources, plus one search across sites, phones, trails, permits, events and documents.
All thirteen campgrounds with Recreation.gov site inventories and numbered site maps for the nine campgrounds outside the Valley. Mark your own campsite and your car.
An offline shuttle planner built on the NPS timetable, with directed stop order, transfers and stop timetables.
Curated events in a month view with Pacific-time recurrence, filters, saved views and shareable filter links, merged with the NPS calendar when a snapshot is saved.
Field status, fire and smoke, and seasonal risk screens that show every source with its own time and state and never present a snapshot as current after 48 hours.
Five official PDFs bundled for offline reading, with a sun and terrain-shadow preview, permit guides, contacts and a GIS explorer for optional park-wide packs.
